## Structure and components

- [statement] PrintNinja’s game proofing guide warns that digitally printed proof components are not color accurate; custom card sizes or rounded corners require tooling priced by the account manager. Its proof turnaround is approximately 3-4 weeks and may increase for specialty options. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-04-28) — https://printninja.com/proofing-options/ · keywords: Bulk offset game manufacturing and sourcing
- [statement] PrintNinja’s physical-proof page lists an approximate 3–4-week turnaround and warns that digitally printed proof components are not color accurate. Custom card sizes and rounded corners require a tooling fee whose price is unspecified. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-04-28) — https://printninja.com/proofing-options/ · keywords: Bulk offset game manufacturing and sourcing

## How it works

- [statement] Panda says it discards printing plates after every print run because storage is impractical; a reorder should not be budgeted on assumed plate reuse. This statement does not disclose reorder setup charges. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://pandagm.com/docs/how-many-times-can-plates-and-molds-be-reused/ · keywords: Bulk offset game manufacturing and sourcing

## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] Delano requires a 50% production deposit and the balance before shipment. Its quoted material costs may change; labor pricing is firm for 30 days after quotation. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://delanogames.com/resources/ · keywords: Bulk offset game manufacturing and sourcing
- [statement] PrintNinja’s terms consider an order complete when the defect rate is under 2%; above 2% they allow a proportional refund or replacement copies at the supplier’s choice. This is a contractual remedy threshold, not a measured production defect rate. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://printninja.com/about/terms/ · keywords: Bulk offset game manufacturing and sourcing

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] PrintNinja’s listed standard $450 physical proof covers one offset press sheet on 300 gsm coreless stock and a digitally printed tuck box; it excludes laminations, specialty options, instructions and rigid boxes. It cannot verify every selected production option. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-02) — https://printninja.com/printing-prices/card-game-printing/ · keywords: Bulk offset game manufacturing and sourcing

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Operator Brandon Rollins defines landed cost as manufacturing plus warehouse freight, customs and tariffs; Panda separately excludes shipping from manufacturing price. Compare delivered costs rather than only factory unit prices. (medium confidence) — https://brandonthegamedev.com/how-much-you-should-spend-on-board-game-manufacturing/ · keywords: Bulk offset game manufacturing and sourcing · also: https://pandagm.com/our-process/
- [statement] Brandon Rollins advises evaluating sample ink and material quality and the supplier’s communication before selecting a printer; this is operator advice rather than comparative supplier test data. (low confidence) — https://brandonthegamedev.com/how-much-you-should-spend-on-board-game-manufacturing/ · keywords: Bulk offset game manufacturing and sourcing
- [statement] PrintNinja says ocean delivery dates are approximate because customs, weather and holidays can disrupt shipping. Panda separately excludes door-to-door shipping from manufacturing prices; compare delivered project quotes rather than manufacturing-only unit prices. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://printninja.com/help/ · keywords: Bulk offset game manufacturing and sourcing · also: https://pandagm.com/our-process/

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Published general minimums differ: PrintNinja states 500 card games, Panda 1,500 games, and Delano 2,000 card or board games. These statements do not establish a reduced repeat-run minimum. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://pandagm.com/our-process/ · keywords: Bulk offset game manufacturing and sourcing · also: https://printninja.com/help/, https://delanogames.com/resources/
- [statement] Panda describes digital proof approval, a near-final Pre-Production Copy before mass production, and a Mass Production Copy checkpoint before final assembly. These are manufacturer-described controls, not independent quality measurements. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://pandagm.com/our-process/ · keywords: Bulk offset game manufacturing and sourcing
- [statement] Panda excludes door-to-door shipping from manufacturing price and permits the buyer’s shipping agent to collect completed games without an additional pickup fee. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://pandagm.com/our-process/ · keywords: Bulk offset game manufacturing and sourcing
- [statement] Delano advises 2-3 weeks for proofing followed by 6-8 weeks of off-season production, conditional on material availability; its September-to-early-December peak season can take longer. This is a production estimate, not delivered lead time. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://delanogames.com/resources/ · keywords: Bulk offset game manufacturing and sourcing
- [statement] PrintNinja’s November 2, 2026 USD example for a 54-card poker deck in a printed tuck box lists Blue Core 280 gsm at $2.69 per deck ($1,343 total) for 500 decks and $1.94 ($1,943 total) for 1,000. Listed examples exclude shipping, sales tax and duties; they are not a quote for a different card count or packaging. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-02) — https://printninja.com/printing-prices/card-game-printing/ · keywords: Bulk offset game manufacturing and sourcing
- [statement] PrintNinja’s help page gives different shipping estimates: its card-specific answer says 3-4 weeks to print plus 6-8 weeks shipping, or about 2 weeks expedited; its general shipping answer says five weeks ocean or one week expedited. These are attributed estimates requiring project-specific reconciliation. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://printninja.com/help/ · keywords: Bulk offset game manufacturing and sourcing
- [statement] PrintNinja’s terms do not guarantee delivery dates and do not guarantee color accuracy without spot or Pantone color, even with hard-copy proofs. A proof approval therefore does not establish an exact CMYK color match across runs. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://printninja.com/about/terms/ · keywords: Bulk offset game manufacturing and sourcing
- [statement] PrintNinja’s terms keep written quotes valid for 90 calendar days only for identical specifications and the named project/customer; changed specifications invalidate the original quotation. Reorder cost continuity therefore needs a fresh valid quote. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://printninja.com/about/terms/ · keywords: Bulk offset game manufacturing and sourcing
- [statement] Panda describes a pre-production copy for approval before mass production, followed by a mass-production copy reviewed before final assembly. Door-to-door freight is excluded from its manufacturing price. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://pandagm.com/our-process/ · keywords: Bulk offset game manufacturing and sourcing
- [statement] PrintNinja’s November 2, 2026 USD table lists a 54-card poker deck in a printed tuck box, Blue Core 280 gsm, at $2.69 per deck and $1,343 total for 500 decks; the displayed unit price is rounded. Printing, packaging and electronic proofs are included; shipping, sales tax and duties are excluded. This example does not quote the commissioned game. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-02) — https://printninja.com/printing-prices/card-game-printing/ · keywords: Bulk offset game manufacturing and sourcing
- [statement] Delano says it reuses dies where possible; it does not promise indefinite die retention or a specific reorder saving in that statement. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://delanogames.com/resources/ · keywords: Bulk offset game manufacturing and sourcing
- [statement] Looney Labs reports combining its same-format titles into shared reprint runs as low as 1000 copies. This is the publisher’s own production arrangement, not a universally available LongPack MOQ. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://faq.looneylabs.com/non-gameplay-questions/game-materials-faq · keywords: Bulk offset game manufacturing and sourcing
- [statement] PrintNinja warns that four-color offset color can vary within a run and more between runs. Looney Labs independently reports that cards made to its established size and corner-radius standards can still differ slightly. Identical digital artwork therefore does not establish indistinguishable physical reprints. (medium confidence) — https://printninja.com/help/ · keywords: Bulk offset game manufacturing and sourcing · also: https://faq.looneylabs.com/non-gameplay-questions/game-materials-faq
- [statement] PrintNinja’s help page gives different shipping estimates: the card-specific answer says 6–8 weeks after 3–4 weeks of printing; the general shipping answer says five weeks for ocean transit. Treat these as differing published estimates requiring project-specific confirmation. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://printninja.com/help/ · keywords: Bulk offset game manufacturing and sourcing
